home.heroSubtitle: Real-time EZVIZ stream ingestion, edge-accelerated insect counting, and automated density alerts. FlyBot transforms ordinary orchard traps into precision agricultural sensors.
home.introCol1: Edge-driven camera pipeline with EZOpen and low-bandwidth HLS streams continuously monitors insect sticky traps without manual scouting visits.
home.introCol2: Proprietary Vision AI models classify agricultural pests (Fruit Fly, Armyworm, Planthopper) in milliseconds with high-confidence bounding boxes.
home.introCol3: Automated MinIO S3 snapshot retention and multi-channel alerting keep agronomists informed of pest surges before damage occurs.
home.bento1Desc: Continuous edge insect counting, multi-species classification, and confidence scoring.
home.bento2Desc: Adaptive SD/HD streaming mode with instant live switcher and camera heartbeat.
home.bento3Desc: Encrypted snapshot archives with configurable retention windows.
home.bento4Desc: Instant PDF/Excel export and automated Telegram / Webhook density alerts.
home.galleryHeading: Trusted across high-tech orchards and smart greenhouses.

manual.title: User Manual
manual.subtitle: Complete guide to setting up and operating your FlyBot Smart Trap Studio
manual.stepAccountDesc: Sign in to the FlyBot Studio console with your authorized agronomist or technician credentials.
manual.stepPairingDesc: Enter your camera Serial Number (SN) and 6-letter verification code from the device label to link with EZVIZ Open Platform.
manual.stepSettingsDesc: Set orchard coordinates, trap inspection schedules, and preferred streaming quality modes.
manual.stepGridDesc: Switch between 1x1, 2x2, and multi-camera overview. FlyBot uses low-bandwidth SD streams for grids to conserve cellular data.

manual.stepHeartbeatDesc: Real-time heartbeat indicators immediately report device connectivity interruptions or Wi-Fi dropouts.
manual.stepAiModelDesc: Select pest classification models targeting Fruit Flies (Bactrocera), Armyworms, Brown Planthoppers, or Beetles.
manual.stepConfidenceDesc: Tune confidence thresholds (default 85%) to eliminate false positives caused by dust, water droplets, or leaves.
manual.stepHeatmapDesc: Examine spatial insect distribution on the sticky trap to evaluate pheromone lure effectiveness.
manual.stepTrendDesc: Observe exponential pest population surges plotted automatically against temperature and humidity variables.
manual.stepExportDesc: Generate standardized pest surveillance inspection sheets with timestamps, device serials, and detection tables.
manual.stepAlertDesc: Configure threshold rules to instantly trigger Telegram push notifications when pest count exceeds critical economic levels.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.sec1Body: All camera RTSP and EZOpen video streams are secured with per-device verification tokens. FlyBot never broadcasts private video feeds publicly without explicit farm manager permission.
privacy.sec2Body: Field trap snapshots analyzed by our Vision AI engine are processed strictly for pest classification and density tracking. Crop yields, geographic coordinates, and property details remain strictly confidential.
privacy.sec3Body: Snapshots and detection bounding boxes are persisted in private MinIO S3 object storage with AES-256 encryption. Retention policies can be set to 7, 30, or 90 days with automatic expiration.
privacy.sec4Body: You retain full ownership of all field surveillance data. At any time, administrators can permanently delete camera associations, archived snapshots, and historical pest reports.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.sec1Body: By accessing and utilizing FlyBot Smart Trap Studio, you agree to comply with these terms, governing intelligent trap monitoring, camera integration, and agricultural analytics.
terms.sec2Body: Vision AI pest counts and density classifications are predictive agricultural aids designed to support decision-making. Agronomists should corroborate high-alert anomalies with ground truth field inspections.
terms.sec3Body: Users are responsible for maintaining stable orchard connectivity for IoT cameras. Multi-camera grid streaming incorporates bandwidth-saving SD protocols to prevent cellular data overages.
terms.sec4Body: You may not utilize the platform for unlawful surveillance beyond your agricultural premises, or attempt unauthorized reverse engineering of the Vision AI model APIs.
terms.sec5Body: For hardware deployment assistance, API integration, or enterprise cooperative SLA inquiries, contact support at contact@flybot.studio.
